sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague,
sentences.zh: 我与我的同事

sentences.en: Zolan Kano-Youngs, about Biden's response to the growing number of children showing up at the U.S.-Mexico border.
sentences.zh: 佐兰·卡诺-杨斯谈到了拜登对于美墨边境涌现的越来越多的儿童所采取的应对措施。

sentences.en: It's Monday, March 8th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月8日，星期一。

sentences.en: Zolan, can you describe what's happening right now at the U.S.-Mexico border?
sentences.zh: 佐兰，你能描述一下现在美墨边境正在发生什么吗？

sentences.en: What you're seeing right now at the border is unaccompanied children fleeing poverty, persecution, crossing the border alone, and going to the ports to surrender to border agents
sentences.zh: 你现在在边境看到的是，逃离贫困和迫害的无人陪伴儿童独自越过边境，前往口岸向边境巡逻人员投案，

sentences.en: in increasingly large numbers.
sentences.zh: 人数越来越多。

sentences.en: And when you say increasingly large numbers, how many people are we talking about?
sentences.zh: 当你提到人数越来越多时，我们指的是多少人？

sentences.en: Well, Michael, just this past January, border patrol agents caught nearly 6,000 unaccompanied children crossing the border.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，就在今年一月，边境巡逻人员抓获了近6000名越境的无人陪伴儿童。

sentences.en: That's nearly double compared to the number of crossings that were recorded in January of 2020.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是2020年一月记录的越境人数的两倍。

sentences.en: So this steady increase of unaccompanied children really is spreading anxiety throughout the government
sentences.zh: 因此，无人陪伴儿童的持续增加确实在整个政府内部引发了焦虑，

sentences.en: and is providing the Biden administration with its first real challenge at the border and coming only, what, roughly 40 days after he came into office.
sentences.zh: 这也给拜登政府带来了上任仅约40天后的第一个真正挑战。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So not a lot of time to prepare for this.
sentences.zh: 所以没有多少时间来准备应对这件事。

sentences.en: Not a lot of time, but, you know, officials within the government would say that they need to respond now.
sentences.zh: 确实没多少时间，但你知道，政府内部的官员会说他们需要立即做出回应。

sentences.en: These crossings are expected to continue.
sentences.zh: 预计这些越境行为还会持续。

sentences.en: Do we know why there's such a meaningful increase in crossings by unaccompanied minors?
sentences.zh: 我们知道为什么无人陪伴未成年人的越境人数会有如此显著的增长吗？

sentences.en: So there's been longstanding drivers of migration, poverty, persecution, gang violence.
sentences.zh: 长期以来一直存在导致移民的驱动因素，如贫困、迫害和帮派暴力。

sentences.en: Now you add on top of that what's happened this past year.
sentences.zh: 现在再加上过去一年发生的事情。

sentences.en: We had two hurricanes in the fall that cut off food supply and battered the economy.
sentences.zh: 我们在秋季经历了两次飓风，切断了粮食供应并重创了经济。

sentences.en: And you add that to the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 再加上疫情的影响。

sentences.en: That's another factor that has really exacerbated some of the issues that we've discussed.
sentences.zh: 这是另一个真正加剧了我们所讨论问题的因素。

sentences.en: And then finally, I mean, I was actually just at the border and some of the families I spoke
sentences.zh: 最后，我其实刚去过边境，我交谈过的一些刚抵达的家庭确实表示，另一个原因是新政府的过渡。

sentences.en: to who had recently arrived did say that another reason is the transition to a new administration.
sentences.zh: 他们认为拜登总统在竞选时承诺采取比前任更具同情心的边境政策，因此可能在边境问题上会更宽容。

sentences.en: They perceived President Biden, who campaigned on a more compassionate approach to the border than his predecessor, as potentially being more lenient at the border.
sentences.zh: 所以这背后的一些因素是新的。

sentences.en: So some of the factors behind this are new.
sentences.zh: 有些是旧的且由来已久，但它们结合在一起，造成了看起来像是边境新危机的情况。

sentences.en: Some are older and quite longstanding, but they have combined to create what looks like perhaps a new crisis at the border.
sentences.zh: 这就是政府官员目前发出警示的原因，我们可能正走向前几届政府也曾处理过的相同方向。

sentences.en: That's what government officials are raising a flag about right now that we could be heading in the same direction that previous administrations also dealt with.
sentences.zh: 追溯到2014年巴拉克·奥巴马总统时期，以及后来唐纳德·特朗普总统时期也面临过类似的问题。

sentences.en: Going back to 2014 with President Barack Obama, and then also have a similar issue with President
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 好的，为了让拜登正在做以及未来可能做的事情有一个背景，请帮我理解那两次边境事件，即无人陪伴未成年人的激增，以及奥巴马和特朗普总统是如何应对的。

sentences.en: Okay, so in order to put what Biden is doing and may be doing in the future into some
sentences.zh: 我们先从2014年的奥巴马总统开始。

sentences.en: context, help me understand those two previous moments at the border, these surges in unaccompanied minors, and how Presidents Obama and Trump responded to them.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.zh: 当时奥巴马政府时期越境的无人陪伴儿童数量让政府措手不及。
儿童涌入已成为政府的一场危机，政府正忙于寻找解决方案。

sentences.en: Okay, sure.

sentences.en: So the number of unaccompanied children that were crossing the border in the
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登正在危地马拉。

sentences.en: Obama administration, it caught the administration flat-footed.
sentences.zh: 今天，他会见了中美洲领导人。

sentences.zh: 他希望得到他们的帮助，以阻止无人陪伴未成年人涌入美国。

sentences.zh: 试图在中美洲进行投资，投入约7.5亿美元来解决这些根本原因。

sentences.en: Joe Biden is in Guatemala.

sentences.en: Today, meeting with Central American leaders.

sentences.en: He's hoping to get their help in stopping the surge of unaccompanied minors arriving in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，德克萨斯州南部一个新的移民拘留设施正式开幕。

sentences.en: Of trying to invest in Central America, invest around $750 million to get at those root causes.

sentences.zh: 这加上奥巴马政府期间驱逐出境人数的增加，引发了广泛的强烈反对。

sentences.en: The largest immigration detention center in the country has just opened a 50-acre facility, just 85-
sentences.zh: 所以听起来奥巴马政府为了控制边境，使用了两种有些矛盾的策略。

sentences.zh: 那么请告诉我们特朗普政府在其任期内是如何处理无人陪伴未成年人激增问题的。

sentences.en: Yes.

sentences.en: I mean, you had migrant children that were being held beyond the 72-hour mandate that they're supposed to be held.

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: The United States will not be a migrant camp, and it will not be a refugee-holding facility.

sentences.en: Won't be.
sentences.zh: 所以他让他们更难进入。

sentences.zh: 但一旦他们进入了，一旦有无人陪伴的儿童被带到边境设施，随后又被带到由卫生与公众服务部管理的收容所，

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 他实际上也让他们在系统后端更难被释放。

sentences.en: So on the front end, the Mexican side of the border, the Trump administration actually instituted policies
sentences.zh: 为了让一名无人陪伴的儿童获释，你需要一名亲属出面担任他们的担保人。

sentences.en: that limited the number of asylum seekers that could go to the ports and ask for protection.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普政府实施的政策，许多人会说实际上阻碍了这些亲属出面。

sentences.en: So he makes it more difficult for them to get in.
sentences.zh: 这包括要求采集指纹，并对移民家庭中的每个人进行更严格的背景调查。

sentences.en: But once they are in, once you have an unaccompanied child who's brought to a border facility and then subsequently brought to a shelter managed by Health and Human Services,
sentences.zh: 这与围绕增加驱逐出境和增加对驱逐出境的恐惧的普遍言论相结合。

sentences.en: he actually made it also more difficult for them to be released on the back end of the system.

sentences.en: In order for an unaccompanied child to be released, you would need a relative to come forward and be their sponsor.
sentences.zh: 他让这些无人陪伴的儿童更难离开这些设施。

sentences.en: But the Trump administration implemented policies that many would say actually discouraged those relatives from coming forward.
sentences.zh: 结果就是这些孩子最终被困住了。

sentences.zh: 在应对这两次无人陪伴未成年人激增的问题上，谁的方法被认为最有效？

sentences.zh: 是奥巴马的还是特朗普的？

sentences.en: And the result is these children end up stuck.

sentences.en: Whose approach was seen as the most effective in confronting these two surges of unaccompanied minors?
sentences.zh: 他甚至在去年三月采取了一项新政策。

sentences.zh: 引入了一项根植于新冠疫情的公共卫生紧急规则。

sentences.en: Well, look, there's no question if your measure of success is keeping asylum seekers out of the country,

sentences.en: keeping them south of the border, preventing them from crossing into the United States, there's no question that Trump did that.

sentences.en: And in some places, they were forced to be in these squalid areas that were subject to violence and kidnappings from the cartel.

sentences.en: So where would President Biden's policies at the border land?
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在夜店用黑胶唱片当DJ的时代，你每天晚上都要带300件你最珍贵的财产去工作。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个充满美丽的50年历史文物的活生生的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼表出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能获取所有报道。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.

sentences.en: Unlocked?

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 当过去几周出现这波新的激增，而拜登面临着大同小异的挑战时，他的回应是什么？

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.

sentences.zh: （注：补齐内容）

sentences.en: So, Zolan, given how Presidents Obama and Trump dealt with unaccompanied minors,
sentences.zh: （注：补齐内容）

sentences.en: when this new surge arrives over the past few weeks and Biden faces more or less a similar challenge, what is his response?
sentences.zh: （注：补齐内容）

sentences.en: So, almost immediately, coming into office, you see top administration officials saying, well, look, we are going to approach the border with more compassion.
sentences.zh: （注：补齐内容）

sentences.en: We're going to make good on our campaign pledge of that.
sentences.zh: 我们将兑现竞选时关于此事的承诺。

sentences.en: At the same time, they are also saying, look, we cannot just flip the switch here.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他们也表示，看，我们不能在这里直接一刀切。

sentences.en: You have them actually discouraging migrants very publicly into interviews, saying, do not make this journey north.
sentences.zh: 你看到他们实际上在采访中非常公开地劝阻移民，说，不要踏上这条北上的旅程。

sentences.en: That sounds quite contradictory.
sentences.zh: 这听起来相当矛盾。

sentences.en: Be compassionate, but by the way, the border is closed and don't even try to cross it.
sentences.zh: 既要表现出同情心，但顺便说一句，边境已经关闭，甚至不要尝试越境。

sentences.en: Well, let me explain how it's working on the ground.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我来解释一下它在实地是如何运作的。

sentences.en: So, this pandemic emergency rule that Trump had introduced a year before,
sentences.zh: 所以，特朗普在一年前引入的这项疫情紧急规则，

sentences.en: the Biden administration is keeping it in place, which allows border agents to rapidly deport migrants who cross the border.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府将其保留了下来，这使得边境特工能够迅速驱逐越境的移民。

sentences.en: But the difference here with the Biden administration is they're actually not going to apply it to children who cross the border.
sentences.zh: 但拜登政府与此不同的是，他们实际上不会将其应用于越境的儿童。

sentences.en: They're not doing that now.
sentences.zh: 他们现在没有这样做。

sentences.en: And that is what they would say is their evidence of already a more compassionate, humane approach.
sentences.zh: 而这就是他们所说的证据，证明他们已经采取了一种更富有同情心、更人道的方法。

sentences.en: The fact that you're not rapidly turning away a child who would cross the southwest border alone.
sentences.zh: 即你不会迅速遣返一个独自越过西南边境的儿童。

sentences.en: So, the administration is not expelling these children, not forcing them back to their home countries.
sentences.zh: 所以，政府并没有驱逐这些儿童，也没有强迫他们回到自己的祖国。

sentences.en: So, what is it doing with these unaccompanied minors?
sentences.zh: 那么，他们是如何处理这些无人陪伴的未成年人的呢？

sentences.en: So, Michael, as far as the process for the unaccompanied minors, it's actually a similar process that we saw in previous administrations.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，就无人陪伴未成年人的流程而言，这实际上与我们在前几届政府中看到的流程类似。

sentences.en: That child, once they cross the border, they are taken by a border agent to a border facility.
sentences.zh: 那个孩子一旦越过边境，就会被边境特工带到边境设施。

sentences.en: They are only supposed to be there for 72 hours.
sentences.zh: 他们本应只在那里待72小时。

sentences.en: Those facilities were designed for adults, not children.
sentences.zh: 这些设施是为成年人设计的，而不是为儿童设计的。

sentences.en: And then from the border facility, they're supposed to be taken to a shelter managed by the Department of Health and Human Services until the government can locate their sponsor.
sentences.zh: 然后从边境设施，他们本应被带到由卫生与公众服务部管理的收容所，直到政府能够找到他们的担保人。

sentences.en: But here's the issue.
sentences.zh: 但问题就在这里。

sentences.en: Up until last Friday, those shelters managed by Health and Human Services were actually at reduced capacity by almost 40%.
sentences.zh: 直到上周五，那些由卫生与公众服务部管理的收容所的容量实际上减少了近40%。

sentences.en: That's because of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这是因为疫情。

sentences.en: You have these shelters reduce the space so that you can spread people out in the midst of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这些收容所减少了空间，以便在疫情期间将人们分散开来。

sentences.en: So, what has happened is it's created this bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 所以，发生的事情是它造成了这种瓶颈。

sentences.en: If you don't have enough space in the shelters that are supposed to hold the children, that then means that those children are going to be in the facilities
sentences.zh: 如果你在应该容纳儿童的收容所里没有足够的空间，那就意味着这些儿童将会在边境的设施里

sentences.en: where they're not supposed to be along the border for a longer period of time.
sentences.zh: 待上更长的时间，而他们本不应该待在那里。

sentences.en: And when I talk to officials on the ground, they are raising alarm about this.
sentences.zh: 当我与实地官员交谈时，他们对此敲响了警钟。

sentences.en: And you even saw the Biden administration acknowledge this just this past Friday when they directed those shelters for children to go back to the capacity that they had before the pandemic to create more space.
sentences.zh: 你甚至看到拜登政府就在上周五承认了这一点，当时他们指示那些儿童收容所恢复到疫情前的容量，以创造更多空间。

sentences.en: But it really is starting to look like a similar challenge that we saw not only under the Trump administration, but also under the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 但这看起来确实像是一个不仅在特朗普政府时期，而且在奥巴马政府时期我们也曾见过的挑战。

sentences.en: So, to recap,
sentences.zh: 所以，总结一下，

sentences.en: Biden's intent to create a more humane approach to what to do with unaccompanied minors is just bumping up against all kinds of challenges that are making it difficult to not recreate the same problems of Trump and Obama.
sentences.zh: 拜登想要为无人陪伴未成年人的处理方式创造一种更人道的方法，却撞上了各种各样的挑战，这使得他很难不重蹈特朗普和奥巴马时期的覆辙。

sentences.en: And it also risks him now being accused of not making good on his campaign pledge of this more compassionate and humane approach to the border.
sentences.zh: 这也让他面临被指责未能兑现其竞选时关于边境问题采取更富有同情心和人道主义方法的承诺的风险。

sentences.en: We are dedicated to achieving and, quite frankly, are working around the clock to replace the cruelty of the past administration with an orderly,
sentences.zh: 我们致力于实现，坦率地说，正在夜以继日地工作，用一个有序的、

sentences.en: humane and safe immigration process.
sentences.zh: 人道的和安全的移民程序来取代上届政府的残忍做法。

sentences.en: You know, just earlier this week, we kind of heard it from one of his top administration officials.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就在本周早些时候，我们从他的一位高级政府官员那里听到了这种说法。

sentences.en: It is hard and it will take time.
sentences.zh: 这很难，而且需要时间。

sentences.en: The Homeland Security Secretary said.
sentences.zh: 国土安全部长这样说道。

sentences.en: We need individuals to wait, and I will say that they will wait with a goal in mind.
sentences.zh: 我们需要个人等待，我会说他们会带着目标去等待。

sentences.en: We're not saying don't come.
sentences.zh: 我们不是说不要来。

sentences.en: We're saying don't come now.
sentences.zh: 我们是说现在不要来。

sentences.en: And that is our ability to rebuild as quickly as possible a system so that they don't have to take the dangerous journey.
sentences.zh: 这是我们尽可能快地重建系统的能力，这样他们就不必踏上危险的旅程。

sentences.en: And we can enable them to access humanitarian relief from their countries of origin.
sentences.zh: 我们可以使他们能够从原籍国获得人道主义援助。

sentences.en: And he said that they need time to unwind some of the restrictions in place at the border.
sentences.zh: 他说，他们需要时间来解除边境现行的一些限制。

sentences.en: They need time to build up the kind of shelters that we've described that would house children that cross the border alone.
sentences.zh: 他们需要时间来建立我们所描述的那种可以安置独自越境儿童的收容所。

sentences.en: So for them, it's trying to work quickly to address what has really become one of their early,
sentences.zh: 所以对他们来说，这是在努力快速工作，以解决这届政府早期面临的挑战之一，

sentences.en: immediate challenges of this administration and one that involves actual lives at the border.
sentences.zh: 这是一个紧迫的挑战，而且涉及边境上的真实生命。

sentences.en: So on Friday, we talked to our colleague, David Sanger, one of your fellow White House reporters,
sentences.zh: 所以周五，我们和我们的同事大卫·桑格谈过，他是你们白宫记者同行之一，

sentences.en: about a different case study into how President Biden is governing in these early days.
sentences.zh: 关于拜登总统在执政初期如何治理的另一个案例研究。

sentences.en: And it involved difficult decision making around Saudi Arabia and its crown prince.
sentences.zh: 这涉及围绕沙特阿拉伯及其王储的艰难决策。

sentences.en: And the way Biden responded there is somewhat at odds with the way he talked during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 拜登在那里的反应方式与他在竞选期间的言论有些不一致。

sentences.en: The subject of immigration seems different.
sentences.zh: 移民问题似乎有所不同。

sentences.en: It seems like Biden is in many ways doing what he said he would do.
sentences.zh: 看起来拜登在很多方面都在做他所说要做的事情。

sentences.en: And yet he's finding it's still very, very complicated to try to keep his word.
sentences.zh: 然而他发现，试图信守诺言仍然非常、非常复杂。

sentences.en: So in your mind, what are we learning about Biden from his approach to this increase of unaccompanied minors at the border?
sentences.zh: 那么在你看来，从他处理边境无人陪伴未成年人增加的问题上，我们对拜登了解到了什么？

sentences.en: So what I think we're learning about President Biden and really his administration is that, yes, he made these ambitious promises during his campaign.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们对拜登总统以及他的政府真正了解的是，是的，他在竞选期间做出了这些雄心勃勃的承诺。

sentences.en: He said he was going to be committed to restoring a process for these asylum seekers, including unaccompanied children.
sentences.zh: 他说他将致力于恢复这些寻求庇护者的程序，包括无人陪伴的儿童。

sentences.en: And you're seeing him go forward with it, despite criticism from those some on the left who say he's moving too slow,
sentences.zh: 你看到他正在推进这项工作，尽管受到左派中一些人的批评，他们说他行动太慢，

sentences.en: despite the criticism from those on the right who say that he shouldn't be processing any asylum seekers into the United States in the middle of a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 尽管受到右派中一些人的批评，他们说他不应该在疫情期间处理任何进入美国的寻求庇护者。

sentences.en: But what we know here is that regardless of how ambitious his goals are, Michael,
sentences.zh: 但我们在这里知道的是，无论他的目标有多么雄心勃勃，迈克尔，

sentences.en: is that he has before him a really difficult logistical challenge here in order to make good on this crucial piece of his immigration agenda.
sentences.zh: 他面前确实面临着一个非常困难的后勤挑战，以便兑现他移民议程中这一关键部分。

sentences.en: He is going to need to build up capacity at the border.
sentences.zh: 他将需要增加边境的容量。

sentences.en: The clock is ticking for him right now.
sentences.zh: 现在时间对他来说很紧迫。

sentences.en: So will he be able to unwind his predecessors' immigration restrictions while building a system that can process these migrants at a quick enough pace?
sentences.zh: 那么他能否在解除前任移民限制的同时，建立一个能够以足够快的速度处理这些移民的系统呢？

sentences.en: That's really the question going forward.
sentences.zh: 这确实是未来的问题。

sentences.en: I guess perhaps my question was flawed.
sentences.zh: 我想也许我的问题有缺陷。

sentences.en: It feels like what we're learning is the depth of the complexity of this problem rather than exactly how Joe Biden is going to be responding to it.
sentences.zh: 感觉我们所了解的是这个问题的复杂程度，而不是乔·拜登将如何确切地应对它。

sentences.en: That might take longer to understand.
sentences.zh: 这可能需要更长时间才能理解。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Look, if you're President Biden, it is not very hard to criticize the Trump administration's approach to the border.
sentences.zh: 看，如果你是拜登总统，批评特朗普政府的边境政策并不难。

sentences.en: It is very hard to actually approach this challenge yourself and create a system where you can actually process these migrants at a fast enough rate.
sentences.zh: 真正亲自处理这一挑战，并创建一个能够以足够快的速度处理这些移民的系统，是非常困难的。

sentences.en: Zolan, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 佐兰，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: On Friday afternoon, former President Trump criticized the Biden administration for its handling of the situation at the border, calling it, quote, totally out of control.
sentences.zh: 周五下午，前总统特朗普批评拜登政府处理边境局势的方式，称其为，引用原话，完全失控。

sentences.en: That prompted a swift response from White House Press Secretary Jen Psaki.
sentences.zh: 这引起了白宫新闻秘书珍·普萨基的迅速回应。

sentences.en: Former President Trump?
sentences.zh: 前总统特朗普？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We don't take our advice or counsel from former President Trump on immigration policy, which was not only inhumane but ineffective over the last four years.
sentences.zh: 我们不会接受前总统特朗普关于移民政策的建议或忠告，他在过去四年里的政策不仅不人道，而且无效。

sentences.en: We're going to chart our own path forward, and that includes treating children with humanity and respect and ensuring they're safe when they cross our borders.
sentences.zh: 我们将规划自己的前进道路，这包括以人道和尊重对待儿童，并确保他们在越过我们的边境时是安全的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他事情。

sentences.en: Mr. Sass.
sentences.zh: 萨斯先生。

sentences.en: Mr. Sass.
sentences.zh: 萨斯先生。

sentences.en: No, Mr. Schumer.
sentences.zh: 不，舒默先生。

sentences.en: Mr. Schumer, aye.
sentences.zh: 舒默先生，赞成。

sentences.en: No, Senator Bush has changed the vote.
sentences.zh: 不，布什参议员改变了投票。

sentences.en: If not, the yeas are 50.
sentences.zh: 如果没有，赞成票为50。

sentences.en: The days are 49.
sentences.zh: 反对票为49。

sentences.en: The bill as amended is passed.
sentences.zh: 修正后的法案获得通过。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周末，美国

sentences.en: Senate passed President Biden's $1.9 trillion stimulus package, the largest anti-poverty effort in a generation and a sweeping attempt to stabilize the economy.
sentences.zh: 参议院通过了拜登总统的1.9万亿美元刺激计划，这是这一代人中最大的反贫困努力，也是稳定经济的全面尝试。

sentences.en: A year into the pandemic, the package includes direct one-time payments of up to $1,400 for hundreds of millions of Americans, jobless aid of $300 a week through the summer,
sentences.zh: 疫情爆发一年后，该计划包括为数亿美国人提供最高1400美元的一次性直接付款，整个夏天每周300美元的失业救济金，

sentences.en: and funding for vaccine distribution and school reopenings.
sentences.zh: 以及为疫苗分发和学校重新开放提供资金。

sentences.en: Despite polls showing widespread bipartisan support for the package, not a single Republican senator supported it.
sentences.zh: 尽管民调显示该计划得到了广泛的两党支持，但没有一位共和党参议员支持它。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: It's a good day today.
sentences.zh: 今天是个好日子。

sentences.en: In a speech from the White House, Biden said that the bill would bring desperately needed help to the country.
sentences.zh: 在白宫发表的讲话中，拜登表示该法案将为国家带来急需的帮助。

sentences.en: You know, when we took office 45 days ago, I promised the American people that help was on the way.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我们45天前上任时，我向美国人民承诺，援助即将到来。

sentences.en: Today, I can say we've taken one more giant step forward in delivering on that promise that help was on the way.
sentences.zh: 今天，我可以说是我们在兑现援助即将到来的承诺方面又向前迈进了一大步。

sentences.en: The bill now returns to the House of Representatives, which is expected to pass it tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 该法案现在返回众议院，预计明天将获得通过。

sentences.en: And on Sunday night,
sentences.zh: 而在周日晚上，

sentences.en: the head of the New York State Senate called on Governor Andrew Cuomo to resign over the growing number of former aides who have accused him of sexual harassment.
sentences.zh: 纽约州参议院领袖呼吁州长安德鲁·科莫辞职，因为越来越多的前助手指控他性骚扰。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the demand from a fellow Democrat, Andrea Stewart-Cousins, could be a potential turning point for Cuomo.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，来自民主党同僚安德烈·斯图尔特-考辛斯的要求可能是科莫的一个潜在转折点。

sentences.en: So far, five women have accused Cuomo of inappropriate conduct or comments.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，已有五名女性指控科莫有不当行为或言论。

sentences.en: Cuomo has insisted that he will not resign, saying he was elected by the people of New York, not the state's politicians.
sentences.zh: 科莫坚称他不会辞职，称他是被纽约人民选出来的，而不是被该州的政客选出来的。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Elise Spiegel, Asta Chaturvedi, Luke Vanderplugge, and Eric Krupke.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由埃莉斯·斯皮格尔、阿斯塔·查图尔维迪、卢克·范德普鲁格和埃里克·克鲁普克制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lisa Chow and engineered by Daniel Powell.
sentences.zh: 由丽莎·周编辑，丹尼尔·鲍威尔担任工程设计。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场痛苦、混乱，有时又令人激动的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一集中，我和莎拉·凯尼格一起，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 地铁。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你获取播客的地方收听。
